observations:
- orchestra/score/analyze.py (new): Finding and Report dataclasses, analyze_phase(records, phase, stage="plan"). It implements the R7-R16 and R22 plan checks, reads record types by string, and has no imports beyond the stdlib.
- orchestra/cli.py (edited): added the `analyze` subparser (phase, --stage plan|close, --json, --cwd, --store) and `_cmd_analyze`. Exit codes are 0 with no error findings, 1 with an error finding, and 2 with a stderr message when the store cannot be opened or the phase record is missing. `--stage close` runs the plan checks only.
- JSON output has `phase`, `stage`, `findings`, plus an extra `skipped` boolean. Text output prints one line per finding and a summary line, or "<phase>: skipped, no active specification".
- "Active" means lifecycle_state "active" for specification, design, and acceptance. Non-withdrawn work-items are those in planned, in_progress, or done, so superseded work-items are also excluded.
- A requirement line must match `R<digits>:`. The compound-requirement check ignores text inside code spans.
- No existing test needed changing. Nothing was committed or edited under .canon/.
